Luzifer Meuterei is the solitary black metal vessel of Lord X Lokison, creator of the black metal sub-genre The Heretic’s Vault Sound forged in isolation and ritual rather than scene or trend. Raw, atmospheric, and willfully obscure, it exists as a closed current where sound becomes invocation and negation alike, unconcerned with audience, validation, or time itself.
From the shadows, Lord X Lokison declares: “I am not a follower of darkness, I am its reflection.”
